display_name: GridMind POC-01 — Generic scooter asset (stationary and non-invasive)
purpose: Exercise GridMind asset identity, component mapping, sensor planning, timestamped sample ingestion, basic data-quality checks and reviewed observations, without claiming scooter health or retrofitting a vehicle.
protective_rules: Do not ride or operate a scooter as part of this software POC.
Do not attach, wire, probe, modify or access vehicle systems.
Start with an independent smartphone resting on a stable surface; its samples are NOT scooter measurements.
Any vehicle-associated stationary test requires an adult/qualified professional's prior review and manufacturer/site safety assessment.
Never collect raw audio, precise travel routes, private location, personal identifiers or registration numbers.
No fault prediction, safety claim, service action, verified economic saving or model-specific thresholds.

phases.title: Software-only sensor pipeline
phases.input: Phone motion sensors on a stable surface away from the vehicle, or labeled synthetic samples.
phases.outcome: Verify units, timestamps, source, null/stale/out-of-order handling and visualization.

phases.title: Evidence and identity model
phases.input: Existing voluntary non-sensitive odometer, maintenance or service observations; petrol/electric identity if known.
phases.outcome: Review contextual observations and permissioned machine passport without inference.

phases.title: Professionally evaluated physical measurements (future)
phases.input: Qualified engineer selects if and what non-invasive external measurements are justified; manufacturer instructions and permissions required.
phases.outcome: Optional controlled stationary validation after a separate safety and data gate.

components.name: Frame and chassis
components.scope: Structural asset identity. No mounting points selected.

components.name: Front brake assembly
components.scope: Safety-critical brake component; no testing or adjustment in this POC.

components.name: Rear brake assembly
components.scope: Safety-critical brake component; no testing or adjustment in this POC.

components.name: Front suspension
components.scope: Suspension assembly; no loading or physical testing in this POC.

components.name: Rear suspension
components.scope: Suspension assembly; no loading or physical testing in this POC.

components.name: Final drive and transmission
components.scope: Configuration depends on actual scooter; not assumed to be a CVT.

components.name: Instruments and displayed odometer
components.scope: Existing vehicle display only; optional manual transcription.

components.name: Controls and lighting
components.scope: Existing controls and lighting; no electrical intervention.

components.name: Low-voltage accessory system
components.scope: Only recorded as a component; no wiring or tests.

components.name: Internal-combustion engine
components.scope: Applicable only if the scooter is petrol-powered.

components.name: Fuel and exhaust system
components.scope: Not accessed or modified during the POC.

components.name: Electric traction motor
components.scope: Applicable only if the scooter is electric.

components.name: Traction battery and battery-management system
components.scope: Restricted high-energy equipment; do not open, access, or instrument.

components.name: Motor controller and power electronics
components.scope: Not accessed, modified, or electrically tested.

components.name: Charging interface
components.scope: No modification or connection; manufacturer documentation only.

measurements.name: Independent phone acceleration test
measurements.can_prove: Proves collection of time-stamped motion samples from a phone at rest on a stable surface.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not measure scooter vibration, faults or road safety.

measurements.name: Independent phone orientation-rate test
measurements.can_prove: Proves a separate time-stamped motion channel and source identity.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not measure wheel speed or scooter mechanical condition.

measurements.name: Existing visual/maintenance observation
measurements.can_prove: Tests provenance, categorical input and observation review.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not establish machine health or fault cause.

measurements.name: Existing odometer reading
measurements.instrument: Visible odometer or pre-existing trip record
measurements.can_prove: Provides usage context for a future comparison when independently obtained.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not establish engine hours, distance during the POC or battery health.

measurements.name: Existing service record / OEM diagnosis
measurements.can_prove: Provides historical context with a clearly identified source.
measurements.cannot_prove: Cannot be treated as a current or verified fault.

measurements.name: Frame vibration candidate
measurements.can_prove: Could measure scooter structural motion in an engineer-approved, stationary test.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not independently diagnose bearings, alignment or vehicle safety.

measurements.name: Petrol-engine surface temperature candidate
measurements.can_prove: Could provide temperature observations with known location and conditions.
measurements.cannot_prove: Cannot prove overheating without OEM limits, comparable context and calibration.

measurements.name: EV motor external temperature candidate
measurements.can_prove: Could provide motor thermal observation in an approved stationary setting.
measurements.cannot_prove: Cannot prove battery safety, motor efficiency or fault cause.

measurements.name: Stationary sound-pattern candidate
measurements.can_prove: May support relative sound-pattern comparisons without storing raw audio.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not provide calibrated sound-pressure level or component diagnosis by default.

measurements.name: Existing petrol use record
measurements.can_prove: Records operating context if its provenance can be established.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not identify fuel inefficiency or mechanical fault.

measurements.name: Existing documented charging energy
measurements.can_prove: Records energy input where a measured and attributable source exists.
measurements.cannot_prove: Does not determine traction-battery health, motor demand, or machine-level loss.

measurements.name: External EV electrical measurement candidate
measurements.instrument: Qualified electrical power instrument selected by a professional
measurements.can_prove: Possible future study subject to manufacturer and qualified engineer approval.
measurements.cannot_prove: Not authorized for battery probing, pack access, wiring modifications, or user installation.

finding_policy: Allowed result: data received, insufficient or inconsistent quality, or a non-causal change between comparable measurements. Specific faults and repair advice remain blocked.
legacy_equipment_transfer: The physical asset ID, component map, observation provenance and quality gate can later be reused for a conventional factory asset without making the scooter a commercial machine taxonomy entry.
